values.meaning: bonus physical damage to most wounded enemy champion based on missing health
values.quote: {{as|{{ap|12 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''missing''' health}}

values.meaning: physical damage dealt to all targets hit on arrival
values.quote: {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 70|critScaling=true}}
values.binNote: Formula also includes a multiplicative crit-chance/crit-damage term ((CritMod=0.7 x critChance)*(critDamage-1)) not expressible as a simple additive term; recorded as the base 120% AD ratio, crit scaling noted in mechanics.

values.meaning: slow applied to the primary struck target
duration of the slow applied to the primary struck target
cast time triggered upon striking an enemy champion, before the automatic attack command
values.quote: '''Viego''' will enter a {{fd|0.25}}-second [[cast time]] if he strikes an enemy champion.
values.binNote: No bin row carries this post-strike cast-time value; the sheet's ViegoR.LockoutTime (1.5) does not match this 0.25 number, so this appears to be wiki-only tooltip text not represented in the bin data available.

mechanics.claim: Upon arrival, Viego applies on-hit effects to the most wounded enemy champion hit.
After the post-strike cast time, Viego automatically basic-attacks the struck champion, ignoring the player's prior movement input.
mechanics.quote: After this cast time, he will automatically receive an attack command against that enemy. Previous movement inputs from the player are ignored.

mechanics.claim: The strike to the primary champion is tagged as both basic damage and spell damage, so it triggers spell effects as well as on-hit/on-attack-relevant interactions; the damage to other enemies is area damage.
mechanics.quote: To the struck champion deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}; to all other enemies, deals {{tip|area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The strike to the champion can be dodged and blocked, but not missed (from blind effects).
mechanics.quote: ''Heartbreaker's'' strike to the champion can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, but not {{tip|blind|missed}}.

mechanics.claim: Viego gains displacement immunity during the blink and cannot be deterred by crowd control while casting.
mechanics.quote: '''Viego''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location.

mechanics.claim: Other enemies hit besides the primary target are knocked back rather than taking the missing-health bonus damage or slow.
mechanics.quote: Other nearby enemies are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
